info.title: Certadomain API
info.description:
JSON API behind https://certadomain.com. No API key. Every analysis is DNS / registry / CT data only, except `tls`, which makes ordinary HTTPS connections to port 443 of the domain's web hosts; target web pages are never fetched.

**Rate limit.** 60 units per 5 minutes per client IP (fixed window). Most calls cost 1, `tls` costs 2, `takeover` and `lookalike` cost 5. Every response carries `RateLimit-Limit`, `RateLimit-Remaining` and `RateLimit-Reset` (seconds until the window ends); 429 adds `Retry-After`. An edge rate limit of 100 requests per 5 minutes per IP also applies.

**Errors.** 4xx/5xx bodies are `application/problem+json` (RFC 9457) with a stable `error` code. The exception is 404 (unknown path, or an id that is not stored), whose body is replaced by an HTML page at the CDN; use the status code. An expired report is a 410 with a normal problem body.

**Caching.** Results are stored per domain (about 1 hour; CT 2 hours); `cached` and `analyzed_at` say which you got. There is no way to force a refresh.

**Compatibility.** Within /v1, fields are only added, never removed or renamed; ignore unknown properties. Scores and grades are a prioritization aid and their weighting may change - rely on `findings[].code` for decisions.

**Browsers.** CORS allows only https://certadomain.com. Call the API from your server, not from another site's page.

license.name: Free to use within the rate limit

get.description: Email authentication (60%), DNS health (25%) and registration (15%) in one 0-100 score with an A-E grade and up to 6 prioritized actions. Counts as 1 against the rate limit.
Nameserver redundancy and authoritative answers, SOA / delegation consistency, DNSSEC, CAA and MX resolution. Counts as 1 against the rate limit.
RFC-compliant lookup with organization-domain inheritance and a recursive SPF 10-lookup count. Counts as 1 against the rate limit.

post.summary: Same as GET, with a JSON body
post.description: Accepts `{"domain": "example.com"}` (the legacy `url` key is also read). Counts as 1 against the rate limit.

get.description: Scores domain-name patterns, DNS signals and registration age. A heuristic, not a verdict from a blocklist. Counts as 1 against the rate limit.
Merges crt.sh and certspotter. Only names that ever had a TLS certificate appear, and entries may be stale. Counts as 1 against the rate limit.

502.description: Both Certificate Transparency sources failed (error `ct_unavailable`). Retry later.

get.description: DNS-only scan of up to 100 CT-discovered subdomains; no page is ever fetched. Can take 10+ seconds. Counts as 5 against the rate limit.

502.description: Both Certificate Transparency sources failed (error `ct_unavailable`). Retry later.

get.description: Generates up to 220 typosquatting / homograph candidates and reports the registered ones, ranked by abuse risk. Takes 4-6 seconds. Counts as 5 against the rate limit.

Connects to port 443 of <domain>, www.<domain> and mta-sts.<domain> (when MTA-STS is published) from AWS Tokyo and checks the certificate (expiry, name, chain, key, signature, CAA), TLS 1.3 / 1.0 / 1.1 support, HSTS and the MTA-STS policy. Ordinary HTTPS handshakes only (at most 5 per host); redirects are not followed. A host may be unreachable from AWS only. Counts as 2 against the rate limit.

503.description: The TLS check is busy (it runs with little concurrency, apart from the other endpoints). Sent by API Gateway, so the body is not problem details. Retry after a few seconds.

post.summary: Store a shareable copy of a result
post.description: The server re-reads the result itself (the content cannot be supplied), stores it for 30 days and returns an unguessable id. Limited to 20 creations per 5 minutes per IP and a global daily ceiling (429 `report_limit`). Counts as 1 against the API rate limit.

get.description: Returns the stored document. Reads do not count against the report limit. A report that has passed its 30 days answers 410 `report_expired` for as long as the stored item still exists (storage removes expired items within about 2 days); after that the id answers 404, the same as one that never existed.

404.description: No report with this id: never created, or already purged after it expired. Use the status code only: the CDN replaces this response's body with the site's HTML page, so do not parse it.

get.description: Links to the spec and docs. Not rate limited.

category.description: dmarc, spf, dkim, mx, ns, dnssec, caa, registration ...

code.description: Stable machine-readable finding code, e.g. SPF_LOOKUP_EXCEEDED. Documented in the site glossary.

params.description: Values the message for this code needs (counts, hosts, dates).

source.description: rdap, jprs-whois or similar; absent data means the TLD publishes none.

locked.description: Transfer lock; null when the registry status is not conclusive.

dnssec.description: Registry delegationSigned flag (data only; see DnsHealth.dnssec for behaviour).

domain.description: The normalized domain that was analysed (lower case, punycode).

analyzed_at.description: Unix time the analysis ran; with cached=true this is when it ran, not when it was served.

cached.description: True when this is a stored result (up to one hour old for most tools).

status.description: ok, lame, timeout, unresolved, private, unchecked ...

serial.description: SOA serial as answered by this server.

mail_servers.description: MX hosts (up to 5) and their IPv4 addresses.

actions.description: Up to 6 prioritized findings, critical first.

ip.description: The public IPv4 that was connected to (port 443).

verified.description: The certificate passed verification for this host name.

skipped.description: Steps left out when the 10-second budget ran out: handshake, certificate, http, caa, tls13, legacy, timeout.

caa_issuers.description: CAA issue values that apply to the domain; null when not looked up.

findings.description: All hosts' findings; params.host names the host.

id.description: Unguessable id; anyone who has it can read the report.

url.description: Shareable page for this report (Japanese site).

url_en.description: Shareable page for this report (English site).

error.description: Stable error code; same value as the last part of type.
